You are reviewing an implementation plan for a multi-provider LLM orchestration plugin.

## Plan under review

The plugin fans a single prompt out to N coding-agent CLIs in parallel, collects each
one's answer, and reaggregates them into a single ranked list of suggestions. Each
provider is an adapter class exposing build_command(), parse_output(), get_env() and
is_available(). Adapters never loop on retry; a shared RetryLadder owns the budget.

### Phase 1 - transport
Introduce a second prompt transport so a multi-KB prompt does not have to ride on argv.
Windows' .cmd shim caps a command line at 8191 UTF-16 code units, and a review prompt is
several KB by construction, so argv-only adapters refuse the slot at the first real prompt.

### Phase 2 - failure classification
Unify auth errors, rate limits, context overflow and exit-zero failures behind one
classifier. Every CLI that can exit 0 while failing must declare measured markers.

### Phase 3 - permission tiers
Every adapter ships the narrowest tool tier on which a toolless review run completes.
A wide flag is admissible only where a probe recorded that the narrow tier stalls.

### Phase 4 - container enrollment
Each new CLI is installed only inside the E2E image and graded against a local stub
under --network none, with argv pinned in a golden file.


Additional context paragraph that exists to make this prompt realistically large; a plan review prompt in this system is several kilobytes of plan text plus the review instructions, and the probe must use one of that size rather than a toy.

## Your task

Return ONLY a JSON array. Each element must be an object with exactly these keys:
  "id"       - a string like "S001"
  "severity" - one of "high", "medium", "low"
  "title"    - a short string
  "detail"   - a string

Return between 2 and 4 elements. Output nothing except the JSON array.
Preliminary thought: I should look at the plan first.

Here is the review:

```json
[
  {"id": "S001", "severity": "high", "title": "argv-only transport", "detail": "A multi-KB prompt exceeds the Windows command-line cap."},
  {"id": "S002", "severity": "medium", "title": "unmeasured retry envelope", "detail": "The retry budget is declared from documentation rather than measurement."},
  {"id": "S003", "severity": "low", "title": "tier not recorded", "detail": "The permission tier ships without a probe transcript."}
]
```
